entry: Read the supplied Jira ticket and reachable source specification in the assigned workstream. Obtain current evidence; do not trust a launch-time status claim or chat text.
exit: Submit one Factory result: status PASS only if the ticket is Ready and its source is sufficient; claims.modifiedFiles must be empty. In the summary and evidence artifacts, include the observed ticket key and status, source locator and revision, evidence references, and reasoning.
If the ticket is not Ready or evidence is insufficient, submit an evidenced non-PASS result explaining what must change. A later retry must inspect fresh evidence.
steps.mission: Decide whether the ticket is sufficiently specified and currently Ready for delivery. Do not groom, edit Jira, approve the design packet or modify repository files.
steps.name: Check delivery readiness
